decisions.reason: A GA4 tracking plugin builds directly on the firm's strong analytics, shop integration and plugin-development capabilities, and with Universal Analytics obsolete the firm can readily absorb client feedback and improve this product commercially.

A Universal Analytics plugin is tied to a discontinued standard, so despite the firm's relevant know-how its knowledge can no longer be applied commercially in a growing way and resources are better shifted to current analytics solutions.

A retail system interface plugin is closely related to the firm's existing interface, customization and shop-operation expertise, giving it enough absorptive capacity to refine the product from implementation experience even if specific connector demand may vary.

A shop relaunch SEO support service matches the firm's established strengths in search marketing, usability, analytics and relaunch projects, so it is easy for management to interpret early results and continue improving the offer.
